usedFor: MailChimp holds your audience, and Whatchimp tags each new subscriber through “Assign Labels To Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Assign Labels To Subscriber” in Whatchimp
bestTemplate.why: New subscribers get labels in Whatchimp, so you can group them from the first day.

watchOut: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” fires for any subscriber, so each one gets the label.
